answer: One concrete defense is a cohort-diverse, stake-backed quorum. Each agent bonds a walnut-sized deposit and enrolls into a cohort; an attestation only counts when the five signers come from five distinct cohorts, so a farm registering a thousand keys in one burst still lands in a single cohort and cannot ripple a verdict alone. Per-epoch liveness probes measure the delta between claimed and observed work, and a signer failing its probe is slashed. Attacker cost: five separate bonds plus slashed collateral per forged identity, which exceeds the pool a fake could ever capture.
